name: Spare Social
summary: One members-owned app for short videos, long videos and channels, photos and stories, posts, groups, events, messages and live streams. It runs at cost with no adverts, feeds people choose with published rules, removal of only what the law requires, and open protocols so members can take their followers anywhere.

areas.name: Joining, accounts and profiles
areas.summary: Signing up with one Spareware login, making a profile, proving who you are when it matters, running several profiles, finding people you know, getting back in, and leaving cleanly.

features.name: Sign up with one Spareware login
features.does: Join in under a minute with a passkey, a handle and a display name, using the same login as every other Spareware app.

parts.name: Spareware login hook-up
parts.what: Use the kit's account service and passkey sign-in (KIT-A1-F2-P1), passwords as a fallback.

parts.name: Sign-up flow
parts.what: Screens for handle, display name and agreeing to the published rules, plus a date of birth checked against the age rules; only the age band and the month it next changes are kept, never the full date, matching the kit's promise to prove age without sharing more (KIT-A2-F8).

parts.name: Handle rules
parts.what: Unique handles, reserved words, look-alike and impersonation checks, a history of past handles, and a waiting period before a released handle can be taken again.

parts.name: Sign-up spam guard
parts.what: Uses the kit's sign-up abuse protection (KIT-A1-F1-P4), where the proof-of-work check belongs, with limits set by Spare Social's rules.

features.name: Make a profile
features.does: Add a photo, banner, bio, pronouns, links and an optional place, and see your videos, photos and posts on tabs.

parts.name: Profile record
parts.what: Name, handle, photo, banner, bio, pronouns, links, place and chosen tabs, stored as operations.

parts.name: Profile page
parts.what: One page with tabs for short videos, long videos, photos, posts, groups and events.

parts.name: Profile links list
parts.what: Several links on the profile, opened directly with no redirect tracking.

parts.name: Pinned and featured posts
parts.what: Pin up to a few posts or videos to the top of the profile.

features.name: Prove who you are when it matters
features.does: Get an optional badge that shows a real person, organisation or public figure is who they say, or use your own web address as your handle.

parts.name: Own web address as handle
parts.what: Prove an account owns a domain name by a DNS record or a file on the site.

parts.name: Optional identity check
parts.what: Uses the kit's identity check (KIT-A2-F1-P2) through an accredited provider, keeping only the result.

parts.name: Organisation check
parts.what: Uses the kit's business number and Charities Register checks (KIT-A2-F7-P1, KIT-A2-F7-P3).

parts.name: Badge rules
parts.what: Published rules for what each badge means and how one is lost, shown on every badge.

features.name: Run several profiles from one login
features.does: Keep a personal profile, a creator channel and a page, and switch between them in one tap.

parts.name: Several profiles per login
parts.what: One login owns several profiles, each with its own followers and settings.

parts.name: Profile switcher
parts.what: A quick switcher that always shows which profile you are acting as.

parts.name: Shared roles on a profile
parts.what: Give other people owner, editor, moderator or viewer roles on a profile, using the kit's team roles (KIT-A1-F7-P1) and the group roles library (SOC-A8-F2-P1).

parts.name: Switch logins on a shared device
parts.what: Keep several people's logins on one shared phone or computer and switch between them, each locked by its own passkey.

features.name: Find people you know
features.does: Invite friends by link or QR code, find contacts who agree to be found, and pick some interests to start.

parts.name: Invite links and QR codes
parts.what: Personal invite links and QR codes that follow back automatically if both agree.

parts.name: Contact matching with consent
parts.what: Match phone contacts with a proven private contact discovery method, not plain hashes that are easy to reverse, only against people who allow it, never keeping the list; a candidate kit part, since other apps need it too, with notices under privacy principle 3A where anything is kept (SOC-A19-F4-P4).

parts.name: Find friends from other networks
parts.what: Look up people you follow elsewhere through the open protocols.

parts.name: Starting interests
parts.what: Pick topics and feeds to start with; the choice only seeds feeds you choose, nothing is tracked.

features.name: Get back into your account
features.does: Recover a lost login, fix a hacked account and sign out of devices you do not recognise.

parts.name: Recovery options
parts.what: Recovery codes, a backup passkey and assisted recovery from the kit (KIT-A1-F4).

parts.name: Hacked account repair
parts.what: Lock the account, review what changed and undo the attacker's actions from the operation log.

parts.name: Sessions list
parts.what: See every signed-in device and sign out of any or all of them.

parts.name: Sign-in alerts
parts.what: Uses the kit's new sign-in alerts (KIT-A1-F3-P3) to tell the member straight away about a sign-in from a new device.

features.name: Pause, leave or hand on your account
features.does: Hide your account for a while, delete it for good, or name someone to look after it when you die.

parts.name: Pause and delete
parts.what: Deactivate to hide everything, or delete with a short grace period and then a full purge.

parts.name: Memorial accounts and legacy contact
parts.what: Turn a profile into a memorial on request and let a named contact manage it, using the kit's after-death handling (KIT-A18-F11-P1).

parts.name: Deceased members' accounts
parts.what: What happens to a deceased member's public posts, videos and memberships, on top of the kit's after-death rules (KIT-A18-F11-P1).

areas.name: Friends, follows and audiences
areas.summary: Who you are connected to: one-way follows, two-way friends, close friends and lists, follower requests, suggestions with a visible reason, and reminders for the people who matter.

features.name: Follow anyone
features.does: Follow a person, channel, page or group and see their posts, with followers and following lists on each profile.

parts.name: Social graph store
parts.what: Follows, friendships, lists, blocks and mutes for millions of members, fast to read both ways.

parts.name: Follow button and lists
parts.what: Follow, unfollow and follow-back buttons, and searchable followers and following lists.

parts.name: Private accounts
parts.what: Members who choose a private account approve each follower first.

features.name: Be friends both ways
features.does: Send a friend request, accept or decline it, and share friends-only posts with people you both chose.

parts.name: Friend requests
parts.what: Two-way friendship record with request, accept, decline and unfriend.

parts.name: Requests inbox
parts.what: One place for friend and follow requests, with filters for people you may know.

features.name: Close friends and lists
features.does: Make lists such as close friends, family or work, and post or browse just for that list.

parts.name: Custom lists
parts.what: Private lists of people that can be used as a post audience or a feed.

parts.name: List manager
parts.what: Add and remove people from lists quickly, including from their profile.

features.name: Suggestions with a visible reason
features.does: See people you may know, each with the reason shown, and turn suggestions off if you like.

parts.name: Suggestion rules
parts.what: Suggestions only from published signals such as mutual follows and shared groups, obeying each member's discoverability choices and the teen contact limits.

parts.name: Why this suggestion
parts.what: A reason on every suggestion and a switch to stop being suggested to others.

features.name: Manage your followers
features.does: Remove a follower without blocking them, hide your counts, and see who follows you.

parts.name: Remove follower and hide follower counts
parts.what: Quietly remove a follower, and choose whether your follower and following counts show; like and view counts are hidden with SOC-A14-F4-P3.

features.name: Birthdays and reminders
features.does: Share your birthday with friends if you want and get a reminder for theirs.

parts.name: Birthday sharing
parts.what: Choose who sees your birthday, separate from the private date of birth used for age rules.

parts.name: Reminders
parts.what: Opt-in reminders for friends' birthdays and your own posting anniversaries.

features.name: Let friends know you are safe
features.does: In an earthquake, flood or other emergency in your area, mark yourself safe so friends and family know.

parts.name: Safety check
parts.what: An emergency check-in that friends can see, opened for an area when an emergency is declared there.

parts.name: Emergency source research
parts.what: How to learn of declared emergencies from official NZ and overseas sources whose terms allow it.

parts.name: Emergency light mode
parts.what: A text-only, low-data mode for the safety check and posts in a declared emergency, for when networks are overloaded, as they were in Cyclone Gabrielle.

features.name: Meet new people
features.does: Opt into a separate dating space with its own profile, shown only to other adults who opted in.

parts.name: Dating decision
parts.what: Decide whether dating belongs in Spare Social, in its own program or nowhere, given its own matching, identity checks, scam risks and legal duties.

parts.name: Dating profiles and matches
parts.what: A separate opt-in profile, mutual matching and a chat that opens only on a match, built only if the dating decision says so.

areas.name: Posts and conversation
areas.summary: Writing posts with text, links, photos and videos to the audience you choose, then reacting, commenting, reposting, saving, tagging, polling and adding context together.

features.name: Write a post
features.does: Post text, links, photos or videos, with mentions, tags, a content label and an honest AI-use answer.

parts.name: Post record
parts.what: One record for every kind of post (text, photo, video, story, poll, event share) with its edit history, stored as operations.

parts.name: Composer
parts.what: Write, attach media, pick the audience, add labels, answer the AI-use question and preview before posting, on phone and web.

parts.name: Rich text
parts.what: Mentions, tags, links and emoji, shown safely so no post can run code on a reader's screen; a candidate kit library, since every app shows text people write.

parts.name: Link previews without tracking
parts.what: Uses the kit's link previews (KIT-A8-F1-P4) for posts and comments, fetched through the safe fetcher (SOC-A17-F7-P2), so readers are never tracked by the linked site; never used for encrypted chats (SOC-A9-F1-P6).

parts.name: Content labels on posts
parts.what: The poster can mark a post as sensitive, a spoiler, or graphic, so viewers can choose to blur it.

parts.name: Post language
parts.what: Each text post carries its language, detected on the device and changeable by the poster, for language filters and search.

features.name: Choose who sees each post
features.does: Post to everyone, followers, friends, close friends, a list, a group, paying members or only yourself.

parts.name: Audience rules engine
parts.what: Checks every read of every post against its audience everywhere Spare Social serves it: feeds, search, links, exports and the API.

parts.name: Audience picker
parts.what: Pick the audience per post, with your usual choice remembered.

parts.name: Audiences on the open network
parts.what: Posts for friends, close friends, lists, paying members or teens leave Spare Social only where the protocol can keep the audience; otherwise they stay here, and the audience picker says so.

features.name: Edit, draft, schedule and archive
features.does: Fix a post with the edits shown, keep drafts on every device, schedule posts and hide old posts without deleting them.

parts.name: Edits with visible history
parts.what: An edited post says so and anyone who can see it can view earlier versions.

parts.name: Drafts on every device
parts.what: Unfinished posts sync across phone, web and computer.

parts.name: Scheduled posts
parts.what: Pick a time and the post goes out then, in the member's time zone.

parts.name: Archive and delete
parts.what: Hide a post from your profile but keep it, or delete it everywhere; deleted posts wait in the recently deleted bin first (SOC-A3-F3-P6).

parts.name: Remove a past version
parts.what: The poster, or a moderator for a legal reason logged in public, can remove a past version from the visible edit history.

parts.name: Recently deleted
parts.what: Deleted posts and stories wait in a private bin for a published number of days, restored on request, then purged on schedule, using the kit's recycle bin (KIT-A15-F9-P1).

features.name: React and comment
features.does: Like or react to a post, comment, reply in threads, and pin or approve comments on your own posts.

parts.name: Reactions
parts.what: A like plus a small set of reactions, counted per post and per comment.

parts.name: Threaded comments
parts.what: Comments with replies in threads, mentions, and photos or short clips in replies.

parts.name: Comment controls
parts.what: Choose who can comment, turn comments off, approve before showing, or hide a comment.

parts.name: Pin and highlight
parts.what: Pin a comment to the top and mark comments the creator liked.

parts.name: Comment order with published rules
parts.what: Sort comments by newest, oldest or most replies, with the rule for each shown.

features.name: Share, repost and quote
features.does: Repost to your followers, quote with your own words, send to a friend, or share a clean link outside.

parts.name: Repost and quote
parts.what: Repost or quote a post, keeping the credit and the original audience rules.

parts.name: Send in a message
parts.what: Send a post into a chat; the card respects the post's audience.

parts.name: Share outside
parts.what: Copy a link, use the phone's share sheet, and give other sites a clean preview card.

features.name: Save and collect
features.does: Save posts into private collections, or make a collection to share with friends.

parts.name: Saved collections
parts.what: Private named collections of saved posts.

parts.name: Shared collections
parts.what: Collections that friends can add to together.

features.name: Polls and questions
features.does: Ask a question with a poll and see the results when it closes.

parts.name: Poll post type
parts.what: One vote per account, cast only by a person, never an agent (SOC-A23-F2-P5), with a closing time and optional hidden results until it closes.

parts.name: Poll results
parts.what: Results shown as plain bars with counts.

features.name: Tag people, places and topics
features.does: Tag people who approve it, tag a place on an open map, and add topic tags.

parts.name: People tags with approval
parts.what: Tags of a person show on their profile only after they approve; what is learned about people from others' posts follows the indirect collection rules (SOC-A19-F4-P4).

parts.name: Place tags
parts.what: Tag a place using open map data, with an exact or rough location.

parts.name: Topic tags
parts.what: Tags that link a post to a topic page.

features.name: Add context to a post
features.does: Write a note that adds missing context to a post; it shows when people who usually disagree both find it helpful.

parts.name: Context notes
parts.what: Writing and rating notes, shown only when raters from different viewpoints agree, by a published method; rating is a people-only action, never done by an agent (SOC-A23-F2-P5).

parts.name: Note-ranking licence check
parts.what: Check the licence of existing open note-ranking code and the papers behind it before any use.

features.name: Post together
features.does: Make a post with another person or page so it shows on both profiles with both names.

parts.name: Co-authored posts
parts.what: A post with several authors who each accept, shown on every author's profile.

features.name: Write long articles
features.does: Write a long article with headings, pictures and videos inside it, readable on other open networks too.

parts.name: Article post type
parts.what: Long articles with headings, inline media and a summary, sent out as the ActivityPub Article type.

parts.name: Article editor
parts.what: Write and lay out a long article with headings, pictures and videos, on phone and web.

areas.name: Photos and stories
areas.summary: Photo posts and swipe-through carousels, a photo editor with our own looks, stories that disappear after a day with interactive stickers, highlights, a profile grid, short status notes and shared albums.

features.name: Post photos and carousels
features.does: Post one photo or a swipe-through set of photos and clips, cropped, ordered and described.

parts.name: Carousel post type
parts.what: Up to a set number of photos and clips in one post, each with its own alt text and tags.

parts.name: Picker, order and crop
parts.what: Pick many photos, drag to reorder, and crop to square, portrait or landscape.

features.name: Edit photos
features.does: Crop, straighten, adjust light and colour, and apply looks designed by the co-op.

parts.name: Photo editor engine
parts.what: Crop, rotate, exposure, contrast, colour and sharpening, run on the device.

parts.name: Our own looks
parts.what: Filter presets designed by members and the co-op, never copied from other apps.

parts.name: Editor screens
parts.what: Simple sliders and before-and-after view on phone and web.

features.name: Share stories that disappear
features.does: Post photos, clips and text that vanish after 24 hours, add stickers, and see who watched.

parts.name: Story record
parts.what: Stories with an expiry time, audience, and a viewer list only the poster sees.

parts.name: Story composer
parts.what: Camera, text, drawing, stickers and music on a full-screen canvas.

parts.name: Interactive stickers
parts.what: Poll, question, slider, countdown, link, mention, place and music stickers, with replies to the poster.

parts.name: Story viewer
parts.what: Tap through, hold to pause, swipe between people, and reply in a message.

parts.name: On-time expiry
parts.what: Remove expired stories everywhere on time, keeping a private archive only if the poster chose it.

features.name: Keep stories as highlights
features.does: Keep chosen stories on your profile as named highlights, and look back at your private archive.

parts.name: Highlights
parts.what: Named sets of past stories pinned to the profile.

parts.name: Private archive and memories
parts.what: Your old stories and posts, with an opt-in look back on this day.

features.name: Arrange your profile grid
features.does: See your photos as a grid, reorder it and pin favourites.

parts.name: Grid with reorder
parts.what: A profile grid you can rearrange without changing post dates.

features.name: Short status notes
features.does: Leave a one-line note that friends see for a day at the top of messages.

parts.name: Status notes
parts.what: Short notes with an audience and a 24-hour expiry.

features.name: Shared albums
features.does: Make an album that friends or a group can add photos to together.

parts.name: Shared album
parts.what: An album with contributors, each owning their own photos.

features.name: Your places map
features.does: See your own tagged photos on a private map.

parts.name: Personal places map
parts.what: A map of your tagged posts, private unless you choose.

areas.name: Short videos
areas.summary: The full-screen vertical video feed, the in-app camera and editor, sounds and music, remixing others' videos with credit, series, templates, and cutting shorts from long videos.

features.name: Watch a short video feed
features.does: Swipe through full-screen vertical videos that start instantly, loop, and can be liked, commented on and shared.

parts.name: Vertical swipe player
parts.what: Full-screen player with swipe, loop, double-tap to like, sound toggle and comments over the video.

parts.name: Preloading rules
parts.what: Load the next few videos ahead, within data saver limits.

parts.name: Playback controls
parts.what: Speed, scrubbing, captions and an auto-scroll switch.

features.name: Record in the app
features.does: Film several clips with a timer, speed setting, flip and flash, hands-free.

parts.name: Camera capture
parts.what: Record clips on phone and web with timer, speed, flip, flash and a grid.

parts.name: Clip timeline
parts.what: Keep recorded clips in order, retake or delete one, and see the total length.

features.name: Edit a short video
features.does: Trim, split, add text, stickers, voiceover, effects, transitions and captions before posting.

parts.name: Short video editor
parts.what: Trim, split, speed and order on the shared video engine, on the device.

parts.name: Text and sticker overlays
parts.what: Timed text, stickers and drawings over the video.

parts.name: Voiceover and mixing
parts.what: Record a voiceover and balance it against the original sound and music.

parts.name: Effects and backgrounds
parts.what: Effects, transitions and background replacement designed by the co-op and run on the device; anything made with AI is marked as such (SOC-A11-F1-P3).

parts.name: Final render
parts.what: Render on the device, with a server fallback for older phones.

parts.name: Auto captions in the editor
parts.what: Generate captions, then fix the words before posting.

features.name: Add sounds and music
features.does: Use your own sound, reuse another video's sound if its creator allows, or pick licensed or free music.

parts.name: Sounds library
parts.what: Every video's sound can become a reusable sound if the creator allows it, with credit.

parts.name: Sound pages
parts.what: A page for each sound showing every video that uses it.

parts.name: Music licensing
parts.what: What licences are needed in NZ and overseas for members to use commercial music, and what they cost at cost.

parts.name: Free music collection
parts.what: Music members and artists offer under open licences, with the licence shown.

features.name: Remix with credit
features.does: Reply to a video with your own, side by side or by clipping part of it first, with the original always credited.

parts.name: Remix permissions
parts.what: Per-video switches for side-by-side, clip-and-reply and sound reuse.

parts.name: Remix layouts
parts.what: Side-by-side, top-and-bottom and clip-then-respond layouts.

parts.name: Credit chain
parts.what: Every remix links back to its source and the source lists its remixes.

parts.name: Download switch with credit
parts.what: A per-video switch that lets others save the video to their device, with the creator's handle and a link added to the saved copy.

features.name: Series and templates
features.does: Link short videos into numbered parts, and reuse an edit layout someone shared.

parts.name: Series
parts.what: An ordered set of videos with part numbers and a next-part button.

parts.name: Edit templates
parts.what: Share an edit's timing and layout so others can drop in their own clips.

features.name: Cut a short from a long video
features.does: Pick a moment from your long video and post it as a vertical short that links back.

parts.name: Clip to short
parts.what: Choose a range, reframe it to vertical and post it with a link to the full video.

areas.name: Long videos and channels
areas.summary: Uploading and watching long videos, channels and subscriptions, playlists and history, captions in many languages, chapters and links inside videos, premieres, and immersive video.

features.name: Upload a long video
features.does: Upload a video with a title, description, thumbnail, language, licence and visibility, and release it now or later.

parts.name: Video details editor
parts.what: Title, description, tags, language, category, AI-use answer and audience, editable after posting.

parts.name: Thumbnails
parts.what: Upload a custom thumbnail or pick a frame from the video.

parts.name: Licence choice
parts.what: All rights reserved or a Creative Commons licence, shown under the video.

parts.name: Visibility and release
parts.what: Public, unlisted, private, members only, or scheduled for a set time.

parts.name: Made for children
parts.what: A flag for videos made for children that turns off comments, watch-signal collection and personalised discovery for anyone watching them, as US COPPA expects once US children can watch.

features.name: Watch a video
features.does: Watch in any quality with speed, captions, chapters, full screen, picture-in-picture and keyboard shortcuts, picking up where you left off.

parts.name: Video player
parts.what: Our own player with adaptive streaming, quality and speed menus, captions and keyboard control.

parts.name: Chapters
parts.what: Chapters from timestamps in the description, shown on the progress bar.

parts.name: Resume anywhere
parts.what: Your place in each video syncs across devices.

parts.name: Picture-in-picture and background play
parts.what: Keep watching in a small window or listen with the screen off.

parts.name: Timestamps in comments
parts.what: Times written in comments jump the player to that moment.

features.name: Channels and subscriptions
features.does: Visit a channel with its videos, playlists and posts, subscribe, and choose how much to be notified.

parts.name: Channel page
parts.what: A profile laid out for video, with sections the creator arranges.

parts.name: Subscribe and notify setting
parts.what: Subscribe with notifications for all, some or no uploads.

parts.name: Subscriptions feed
parts.what: New uploads from your subscriptions, newest first.

parts.name: Channel web feeds
parts.what: An RSS or Atom feed for each channel, so people can follow without an account.

features.name: Playlists, watch later and history
features.does: Make playlists, save videos for later, see what you watched, and pause or clear your history.

parts.name: Playlists
parts.what: Public, unlisted, private and shared playlists that others can add to.

parts.name: Watch later and history
parts.what: A watch-later list, and a history you can pause, search and clear.

parts.name: Queue and autoplay
parts.what: Queue videos to play next; autoplay follows the one autoplay setting (SOC-A21-F4-P1), off unless you turn it on, with its rule shown.

features.name: Captions and subtitles in many languages
features.does: Add captions, upload subtitle files, accept members' translations, and offer dubbed audio.

parts.name: Caption editor and upload
parts.what: Edit automatic captions or upload WebVTT and SRT files.

parts.name: Community translations
parts.what: Members suggest subtitles in other languages; the creator approves them.

parts.name: Extra audio tracks
parts.what: Several audio languages on one video, chosen in the player; tracks dubbed with AI carry a label and content credentials (SOC-A11-F1-P3).

parts.name: Translated titles and descriptions
parts.what: Titles, descriptions and chapter names in other languages, shown in each viewer's language and found by search.

features.name: Links inside videos
features.does: Add timed cards and an end screen that point to other videos, playlists or websites.

parts.name: Timed link cards
parts.what: Cards that appear at chosen times and link to a video, playlist, post or web address.

parts.name: End screens
parts.what: Suggested next videos chosen by the creator, shown in the last seconds.

features.name: Premieres
features.does: Release a new video at a set time and watch it together with live chat.

parts.name: Premiere countdown and chat
parts.what: A waiting page with a countdown, then the video plays for everyone with live chat.

features.name: Immersive video
features.does: Watch 360-degree, virtual reality and high dynamic range videos.

parts.name: 360 and VR playback
parts.what: Look around inside a 360 video on phone, computer and headset.

parts.name: HDR delivery
parts.what: Research how to keep high dynamic range from upload to screen.

features.name: Podcasts
features.does: Publish an audio show in episodes, or bring one in from its RSS feed, and listen with the screen off.

parts.name: Podcast import from RSS
parts.what: Import a show and its new episodes from its public RSS feed, once the owner proves it is theirs.

parts.name: Audio-only listening
parts.what: Listen to shows and videos as audio only, saving data.

features.name: Fix a published video
features.does: Trim, cut out a section, blur faces or objects, or replace the file of a published video without losing its comments and links.

parts.name: Trim and cut after publishing
parts.what: Trim the ends or cut a section out of a published video and process it again, keeping its link, comments and stats, with the change shown in the video's history.

parts.name: Blur faces and objects
parts.what: Pick faces, number plates or objects to blur through the video, followed from frame to frame, the fix for privacy complaints; face finding meets the biometric code (SOC-A14-F1-P5).

parts.name: Replace the file
parts.what: Swap in a new file for a published video, keeping its link and comments, with the swap noted on the video.

areas.name: Live streaming
areas.summary: Going live from a phone or streaming software, live chat with moderation, guests, replays and clips, audio rooms, and the fast safety response live video needs.

features.name: Go live
features.does: Start a live stream from your phone or from streaming software on a computer.

parts.name: Stream intake
parts.what: Accept streams from phones over WebRTC (WHIP) and from streaming software over RTMP and SRT.

parts.name: Live transcoding
parts.what: Turn each stream into several sizes as it arrives.

parts.name: Low-delay delivery
parts.what: Compare low-latency HLS and WebRTC delivery on delay, cost and scale.

parts.name: Go-live screen
parts.what: Title, audience, AI-use answer and a camera check before going live.

features.name: Live chat
features.does: Chat with viewers in real time, with slow mode, follower-only chat, word filters and helpers who moderate.

parts.name: Live chat service
parts.what: Real-time chat that stays fast with many thousands of viewers, built on the kit's chat service (KIT-A8-F1-P2); a candidate kit part, since other apps' live events need it.

parts.name: Chat moderation tools
parts.what: Slow mode, followers-only, hidden words, timeouts and chat moderators.

features.name: Bring guests on
features.does: Invite other people onto your stream side by side.

parts.name: Multi-guest mixing
parts.what: Mix several cameras and microphones into one stream.

features.name: Replays and clips
features.does: Keep the stream as a video afterwards, and let viewers clip a moment to share.

parts.name: Save as video
parts.what: Save the stream with its chat replay as an ordinary video.

parts.name: Clip a moment
parts.what: Viewers cut a short clip from a live stream or replay, with credit.

features.name: Live audio rooms
features.does: Host an audio-only room with speakers and listeners who raise a hand to talk.

parts.name: Audio rooms
parts.what: Rooms with hosts, speakers and listeners, with recording if the host allows.

features.name: Live safety
features.does: Report a live stream as it happens and have it stopped fast when it breaks the law.

parts.name: Real-time reports and stop
parts.what: A fast report path and a moderator switch that ends a stream at once.

parts.name: Who can go live
parts.what: Published rules on who can go live, informed by the duty to act fast on violent extremist live video.

features.name: Tips during a live stream
features.does: Viewers send a tip that shows on screen during the stream.

parts.name: Live tip alerts
parts.what: Tips shown on stream with the payment fee shown to the viewer.

features.name: Live captions
features.does: Read captions as people speak in live streams and audio rooms.

parts.name: Captions for lives and audio rooms
parts.what: Captions made as people speak in live streams and audio rooms, using the kit's captions (KIT-A19-F4-P1).

features.name: Plan and wrap up a live
features.does: Announce a live ahead with a waiting page, let viewers rewind while it runs, and send them on to another channel at the end.

parts.name: Scheduled lives
parts.what: Announce a live for a set time with a waiting page, a countdown and reminders.

parts.name: Rewind while live
parts.what: Viewers rewind a live stream while it is still running, within a window the streamer sets.

parts.name: Send viewers on
parts.what: At the end of a stream, send viewers to another channel's live stream if that channel accepts.

areas.name: Groups, pages and events
areas.summary: Groups of every size and privacy, running a group well, pages for organisations and public figures, events with invites and reminders, fundraisers for charities, and links to Spare Market listings.

features.name: Start and join groups
features.does: Make a public, private or hidden group, answer join questions, and invite people.

parts.name: Group record
parts.what: Groups with privacy level, members, rules, and their own posts and media.

parts.name: Join requests and invites
parts.what: Join questions, approval, invite links and member removal.

parts.name: Group page
parts.what: Posts, members, about, rules, events and files on one page.

features.name: Run a group
features.does: Share the work with admins and moderators, approve posts, set rules, and keep a log members can read.

parts.name: Group roles
parts.what: Owner, admin, moderator and member, each with set permissions, built on the kit's roles per app (KIT-A1-F5-P2) and shared with profile and page roles.

parts.name: Post approval queue
parts.what: Hold posts for approval, with keyword alerts for the group's own rules using the one hidden-words library (SOC-A12-F2-P1).

parts.name: Group moderation log
parts.what: Members can see what the group's moderators removed and why.

parts.name: Elected group admins
parts.what: A group can elect its admins with the shared voting service.

parts.name: Group insights
parts.what: Admins see member growth, active members and post reach as totals only, counted with no per-person tracking.

parts.name: Admins' legal guide
parts.what: Plain guidance for group and page admins on when they can be liable for others' comments they know about, as in NZ's Murray v Wishart and Australia's Voller case.

features.name: Talk in a group
features.does: Post, comment and chat in the group, sorted into topics, with shared files and guides.

parts.name: Group topics
parts.what: Topics or channels inside a group to sort posts.

parts.name: Group chat rooms
parts.what: Chats that belong to a group and follow its membership.

parts.name: Files and guides
parts.what: Shared files and step-by-step guides inside a group.

parts.name: Anonymous group posts
parts.what: Post in a group without your name showing to members if the group allows it; admins and the law can still see who posted.

features.name: Pages for organisations and public figures
features.does: Make a page for a business, club, charity, council or public figure with contact details, hours and staff roles.

parts.name: Page profile type
parts.what: A profile type with organisation details, opening hours and contact buttons.

parts.name: Page roles for staff
parts.what: Several staff run one page without sharing a login.

parts.name: Page inbox
parts.what: Messages to the page shared between its staff.

features.name: Events
features.does: Create an event, invite people, collect replies, send reminders and updates, and add it to your calendar.

parts.name: Event record
parts.what: Times with time zones, a place or online link, hosts, and audience.

parts.name: Replies and guest list
parts.what: Going, maybe and can't go, with a guest list the host can keep private.

parts.name: Reminders and updates
parts.what: Reminders before the event and updates to everyone who replied.

parts.name: Calendar export
parts.what: Add events to any calendar with the iCalendar standard, using the kit's calendar import and export (KIT-A5-F5-P2).

parts.name: Event map
parts.what: Show the place on an open map with directions.

parts.name: Events near you
parts.what: Find upcoming public events by area and date.

parts.name: Paid tickets
parts.what: Sell tickets through the shared payments service.

features.name: Fundraisers
features.does: Raise money for a registered charity or a cause, with receipts.

parts.name: Charity fundraisers
parts.what: Donations to registered charities through the payment provider, with donation receipts.

parts.name: Fundraising law
parts.what: NZ rules for charitable fundraising, receipts and tax credits, and overseas rules.

parts.name: Charity check
parts.what: Confirms a charity on the NZ Charities Register before its fundraiser opens, using the kit's Charities Register check (KIT-A2-F7-P3).

features.name: Share Spare Market listings
features.does: Share a listing or shop from Spare Market into a post or group; buying happens in Spare Market.

parts.name: Listing cards
parts.what: Rich cards for Spare Market listings, drawn from the kit's listing model (KIT-A5-F1-P1), never from Spare Market's own code.

features.name: Keep groups and pages going
features.does: Hand a group or page to someone else, plan what happens if its owner leaves or dies, settle who controls it, or archive it.

parts.name: Hand over, succession and archive
parts.what: Transfer ownership, name backup owners, pass a group to its admins when the owner leaves or dies, and archive a group so it can still be read.

parts.name: Control disputes
parts.what: When people disagree over who controls a group or page, a member panel decides by published rules.

areas.name: Messages and calls
areas.summary: Private one-to-one and group chats with end-to-end encryption, voice notes, disappearing messages, voice and video calls, sharing posts into chats, broadcast channels, safety inside encrypted chats, and the same chats on every device.

features.name: Chat one to one
features.does: Send texts, photos, videos, voice notes and reactions, reply to a message, edit or unsend, and choose whether to show read receipts.

parts.name: Encrypted messaging
parts.what: Private chats on the kit's chat service (KIT-A8-F1-P2), end-to-end encrypted with the MLS standard (RFC 9420) as set by the kit's encryption decision (KIT-A8-F10-P1).

parts.name: Chat screens
parts.what: Chat list, chat view, replies, reactions, edit and unsend, typing and read receipts with switches.

parts.name: Voice notes
parts.what: Record, send and play voice notes, with optional transcripts made on the device.

parts.name: Message requests
parts.what: Messages from people you don't follow go to a filtered requests folder.

parts.name: Stickers and GIFs
parts.what: Co-op and member sticker packs, with GIF search only through a provider whose terms allow it.

parts.name: Link previews made on your device
parts.what: In encrypted chats the sender's device fetches a link's preview and sends it inside the encrypted message, so the server never sees the link.

parts.name: Check who you are talking to
parts.what: Safety numbers to compare in person, and key transparency so a swapped key is caught without anyone checking by hand.

parts.name: Chat tools, search and files
parts.what: Mute, pin and archive chats, search inside chats on the device, and send documents as attachments.

features.name: Group chats
features.does: Chat with a group, name it, add admins, mention people and run quick polls.

parts.name: Encrypted group chats
parts.what: Group encryption using MLS groups, with members joining and leaving safely; to be built once in the kit beside KIT-A8-F10-P1 and shared with Spare Office.

parts.name: Group chat admin
parts.what: Names, photos, admins, invite links and member removal.

features.name: Disappearing messages
features.does: Set chats so messages delete themselves after a time you choose.

parts.name: Message timers
parts.what: Per-chat timers enforced on every device in the chat.

features.name: Voice and video calls
features.does: Call one person or a group by voice or video, and share your screen.

parts.name: Calls
parts.what: One-to-one and group calls on the kit's call service (KIT-A8-F11-P2), with relay servers run at cost.

parts.name: Call screens
parts.what: Ringing, call controls, screen sharing and a call history.

parts.name: Encrypted group calls
parts.what: End-to-end encrypted calls using SFrame (RFC 9605) with keys from the chat's MLS group, and relays that hide each person's IP address from the others.

parts.name: Captions in calls
parts.what: Live captions in voice and video calls, made on each person's own device so encrypted calls stay private.

features.name: Share into chat
features.does: Send a post, video, profile or event into a chat and talk about it there.

parts.name: Post cards in chats
parts.what: Cards for shared posts that only show if the receiver is allowed to see the post.

features.name: Broadcast channels
features.does: Creators send one-way updates to many followers, who can react and vote in polls.

parts.name: Broadcast channel
parts.what: One-way channels with reactions, polls and a members-only option.

features.name: Stay safe in messages
features.does: Report a chat, block someone, filter requests and blur unwanted images before you see them.

parts.name: Reporting from encrypted chats
parts.what: The reporter's own device sends the reported messages to moderators, so encryption stays intact.

parts.name: On-device image blur
parts.what: Sensitive image detection on the device that blurs until you choose to look; on by default for teens.

parts.name: Lawful access and encryption
parts.what: What NZ and overseas law asks of an encrypted messaging service, and what it cannot ask.

features.name: Same chats on every device
features.does: Use messages on your phone, computer and the web, and restore them on a new phone.

parts.name: Multi-device keys
parts.what: Each device holds its own keys and joins chats securely; to be built in one kit encryption library beside KIT-A8-F10-P1, shared with Spare Office.

parts.name: Encrypted backup
parts.what: Backups the co-op can't read, restored with your recovery key; part of the same kit encryption library.

features.name: Chat with other open networks
features.does: Message people on other open networks from Spare Social.

parts.name: Messaging bridges
parts.what: Research joining open messaging networks without weakening encryption.

features.name: Watch together
features.does: Watch a video together in a chat or call, in step with each other.

parts.name: Synced playback
parts.what: Play, pause and seek in step for everyone in the chat or call.

features.name: Know when an AI reads a chat
features.does: Let your own AI read or send in your encrypted chats only from your own device, and see when someone else's AI can read a chat you are in.

parts.name: AI access on your own device
parts.what: An agent can read or send in encrypted chats only through an MCP endpoint on the member's own device, never through the co-op's servers.

parts.name: Tell others or refuse
parts.what: Everyone in a chat sees when someone's AI can read it, and a chat can be set to no AI readers, which Spare Social's own apps and MCP endpoint obey.

features.name: Chat extras
features.does: Share your live location for a set time, send photos that open once, schedule messages, see when a message was forwarded and share contact cards.

parts.name: Live location for a set time
parts.what: Share your live location in a chat for a set time, then it stops by itself; never offered to teens.

parts.name: View-once and scheduled messages
parts.what: Photos that can be opened once, and messages sent at a time you pick.

parts.name: Forward labels and contact cards
parts.what: Forwarded messages say so, often-forwarded ones go to one chat at a time, and contact cards share a profile in one tap.

areas.name: Feeds, discovery and search
areas.summary: The time-order feed of people you follow, feeds anyone can make and publish with visible rules, a discovery feed whose ranking is published, search across everything, tag and trending pages, local feeds, and your own feed controls.

features.name: Following feed in time order
features.does: See posts from the people, groups and tags you follow, newest first, with nothing hidden.

parts.name: Timeline builder
parts.what: Builds each member's time-order feed from follows, groups and tags, fast at scale.

parts.name: Feed screens
parts.what: Feeds mixed or split by type (videos, photos, posts), switchable at the top.

parts.name: Caught-up marker
parts.what: Remember where you got to and say when you are all caught up.

features.name: Pick or make your own feed
features.does: Choose feeds from a directory, see each one's rules, or build one yourself without code.

parts.name: Feed definition format
parts.what: A published format for a feed's rules that anyone can read before choosing it.

parts.name: Feed plugins
parts.what: Custom feed logic runs as sandboxed plugins with declared permissions.

parts.name: Feed directory
parts.what: Browse, preview and pin feeds, with each feed's rules and maker shown.

parts.name: No-code feed builder
parts.what: Build a feed from people, tags, lengths, languages, places and the human or AI section.

features.name: Discovery with published rules
features.does: Find new videos and people in a discovery feed whose every ranking signal and weight is published.

parts.name: Published discovery ranking
parts.what: The default discovery ranking with its signals and weights open for anyone to read and check.

parts.name: Your signals, your control
parts.what: The watch and like signals used for you, kept on the device where possible, which you can see, pause and reset.

parts.name: Why am I seeing this
parts.what: Every post in a ranked feed explains why it is there.

parts.name: Ranking audit tests
parts.what: Tests that prove the running ranking matches the published rules.

parts.name: Not interested buttons
parts.what: Not interested, show fewer like this, and stop showing this account, applied at once.

features.name: Search everything
features.does: Search people, posts, videos, sounds, tags, groups, events and places, and words spoken inside videos.

parts.name: Spare Social's search needs
parts.what: Spare Social's needs for the kit's one search engine choice (KIT-A6-F1-P1): captions, many languages, every post's audience and posts from other servers, decided in the same note.

parts.name: Search on the kit service
parts.what: People, posts, videos, sounds, tags, groups, events and places indexed in the kit's one search service (KIT-A6-F1-P2), with its audience filters (KIT-A6-F1-P4) checking every result against the post's audience.

parts.name: Search screens
parts.what: Results by type with filters for date, length, language and section.

parts.name: Search inside videos
parts.what: Search the captions so a video is found by what is said in it.

parts.name: Search that ignores macrons
parts.what: Search ignores macrons and matches te reo Māori spelling forms, using the kit's macron-aware matching (KIT-A19-F1-P4), so Maori finds Māori.

parts.name: Other servers' posts searched only with consent
parts.what: Posts from other servers are indexed for full-text search only where their authors allow it, such as Mastodon's indexable flag, and are dropped from the index when they opt out.

features.name: Tags and trending
features.does: Open a tag's page to see its newest and most-liked posts, and see what is trending by a published count.

parts.name: Tag pages
parts.what: Newest and most-liked posts for each tag, and a follow button.

parts.name: Trending with published counting
parts.what: Trending lists counted by a published rule from people's actions only, never agents' (SOC-A23-F2-P5), with checks against fake boosting.

features.name: Local and NZ feeds
features.does: See posts and events from your town, region or all of NZ if you share a rough location.

parts.name: Region feeds
parts.what: Feeds by town, region and country from rough locations members choose to share.

features.name: Your feed controls
features.does: Hide reposts, pick content types, filter languages and set each feed your way.

parts.name: Per-feed settings
parts.what: Show or hide reposts, replies, types, languages and sections per feed.

areas.name: Human and AI sections
areas.summary: Every feed has a Human section and an AI section. Creators declare AI use and the section follows that answer whatever app or tool posted it, bots and agents are labelled, our own AI tools mark what they make, uploads are checked for content credentials and detection signals as hints only, sections work across the open network, and wrong placements are fixed in the open.

features.name: Declare AI use on every post
features.does: Say on every post whether AI was used and how, with your usual answer remembered.

parts.name: AI-use field
parts.what: None, AI-assisted or AI-made, with an optional note on which tools were used.

parts.name: Declaration step
parts.what: The composer asks every time, with the last answer pre-filled, never skipped.

parts.name: Our AI tools mark what they make
parts.what: Background replacement, effects, AI dubbing and alt text suggestions add machine-readable C2PA content credentials to what they make and pre-fill the AI-use answer, as the EU AI Act's article 50 marking duties ask (start dates to be checked).

parts.name: Signing certificate
parts.what: A certificate for signing content credentials from a provider on the C2PA trust list, so other apps accept Spareware's signatures.

features.name: See Human, AI or both
features.does: Switch each feed to show the Human section, the AI section or both, and change it any time.

parts.name: Section filter
parts.what: Every feed, search and profile filters by section on the server.

parts.name: Section switch
parts.what: A clear Human, AI, Both switch at the top of every feed.

features.name: Labelled bots and AI agents
features.does: Know at a glance when an account is a bot or AI agent, and who is responsible for it.

parts.name: Agent account type
parts.what: Bot and agent accounts carry a label and the human or organisation that owns them.

parts.name: Section follows the answer, not the route
parts.what: A post goes to the section its AI-use answer gives, whether it came from the app, the command API, MCP, scheduling, bulk upload, Spare Studio or another client; bot and agent accounts' own posts go to the AI section, and a post an agent sends for a person carries an agent label without changing its section.

features.name: Checked, not assumed
features.does: See content credentials when a photo or video carries them, while moderators get detection signals as hints, never verdicts.

parts.name: Content credentials reader
parts.what: Read and show C2PA content credentials using an openly licensed library.

parts.name: Keep credentials, drop location
parts.what: Keep content credentials on upload while removing hidden location: the location is redacted inside the credentials and the result re-signed, so the credential stays valid.

parts.name: Detection signals research
parts.what: Compare open AI-detection methods on accuracy, bias and licence, for use as moderator hints only.

features.name: Fix wrong sections in the open
features.does: Flag a post in the wrong section; a moderator moves it with the reason logged in public, and the creator can appeal.

parts.name: Wrong-section report
parts.what: A report type for posts in the wrong section.

parts.name: Section move and appeal
parts.what: Moderators move a post with a logged reason; the creator can appeal.

features.name: Mark your work as human-made
features.does: Attach content credentials to photos and videos made in the Spare Social camera or Spare Studio.

parts.name: Sign your own media
parts.what: Add C2PA content credentials when media is captured or exported through Spareware tools, signed with the co-op's certificate (SOC-A11-F1-P4).

features.name: Sections everywhere, across the network
features.does: See the Human and AI sections work for posts from other networks and in comments, replies, messages and live chat, and have your own answers travel with your posts.

parts.name: Posts from other networks
parts.what: Posts from other servers keep the AI-use answer their protocol sends; posts with none are marked as not declared, and each person chooses whether undeclared posts show in their Human section.

parts.name: Comments, replies, messages and live chat
parts.what: Comments, replies and live chat carry the same AI-use answers and agent labels as posts, so a bot's reply never shows in the Human view of a thread, and messages from an agent show its label.

parts.name: Answers and labels sent over the network
parts.what: AI-use answers and agent labels go out with every post: as AT Protocol self-labels, and as a published ActivityPub extension other servers can read.

areas.name: Personal controls and filters
areas.summary: What each person decides for themselves: mute, snooze, block and restrict, hidden words, content labels and how to show them, community filters to subscribe to, who can reach, quote or follow you (bots and agents included), and help when a pile-on starts.

features.name: Mute, block and restrict
features.does: Mute someone you don't want to see, block someone who shouldn't reach you, or restrict them so their comments need your approval.

parts.name: Mute, block and restrict
parts.what: Three levels of distance, enforced across feeds, comments, messages, search and tags.

parts.name: Shared block lists
parts.what: Publish a block or mute list, and subscribe to lists others publish.

parts.name: Blocks that cover every profile
parts.what: A block covers every profile on the blocked person's login (SOC-A1-F4) and new accounts they are likely to make, found by published signals, without showing anyone that the profiles are linked.

parts.name: Snooze for 30 days
parts.what: Snooze a person, page or group for 30 days, after which they come back by themselves.

features.name: Hide words and topics
features.does: Hide posts, comments and message requests with words or tags you choose, for a while or for good.

parts.name: Hidden words
parts.what: Muted words, phrases and tags with an optional end date, matched across languages' spelling forms; the one hidden-words library for posts, comments, live chat, groups and message requests, and a candidate kit library, since other apps filter text too.

features.name: Content labels your way
features.does: For each label, such as nudity, violence or spoilers, choose to show, blur or hide.

parts.name: Label set and choices
parts.what: Spare Social's published label set on the kit's content labels and personal filters (KIT-A10-F13-P1, KIT-A10-F13-P2), with each viewer's show, blur or hide choice per label.

parts.name: Blur and reveal
parts.what: Blurred previews with the label shown and a tap to reveal.

features.name: Subscribe to community filters
features.does: Subscribe to labelling services run by groups you trust, and see why something was labelled.

parts.name: Labelling services
parts.what: A format for independent labellers to publish labels, and for members to subscribe; a candidate kit part, since labels from outside services could serve every app.

parts.name: Labeller directory
parts.what: Find labellers, read their rules and see who runs them.

features.name: Choose who can reach you
features.does: Decide who can comment, message, mention, tag, remix or find you by phone or email.

parts.name: Interaction settings
parts.what: One page for comment, message, mention, tag, quote, agent and discovery settings; the remix switches join it when remixing arrives (SOC-A5-F5-P1).

parts.name: Pile-on limits
parts.what: Turn on a temporary limit so only long-standing followers can reply or message.

parts.name: Quote and repost controls
parts.what: Turn off quotes or reposts of a post, and detach your post from someone else's quote of it.

parts.name: Keep bots and agents away
parts.what: A switch for whether bots and AI agents may reply to, mention, message or follow you, enforced on the command API and MCP as well as in the app.

features.name: Help when you are harassed
features.does: Clear abusive comments in bulk, keep evidence, and get help from Netsafe or the police.

parts.name: Bulk comment tools
parts.what: Select and hide or delete many comments, and block their writers in one go.

parts.name: Evidence export
parts.what: Save a dated record of abusive posts and messages to give to Netsafe or the police.

areas.name: Moderation, legal duties and transparency
areas.summary: Removing only what the law requires, by published rules, in the open: reports from anyone, the rule book, fast removal of illegal material including intimate images and court-ordered content, legal deadlines met around the clock, copyright and trade mark notices, a public removal log, statements of reasons and appeals, a published ladder before any ban, vetted and protected moderators members elect, spam and fake-account defences, and police and government requests.

features.name: Report anything
features.does: Report a post, comment, profile, message, group, event or live stream against a named rule, and hear what happened.

parts.name: Report flow
parts.what: A short flow on every item, built on the kit's report forms (KIT-A10-F3-P2): pick the rule, add detail, choose to block too.

parts.name: Reports as operations
parts.what: Every report and decision is an operation in the kit's reports service (KIT-A10-F3-P1), so the public log and the audit trail build themselves.

parts.name: Reporter updates
parts.what: Tell the reporter what was decided and why, and how to appeal.

parts.name: Report without an account
parts.what: Public web forms on the kit's reports without an account (KIT-A10-F3-P3) for legal notices, privacy complaints, intimate images, defamation, copyright and police, since victims, rights holders and officials often are not members.

features.name: Read the rules
features.does: Read the rules in plain words, each linked to the law that requires it, with every change voted on and dated.

parts.name: Rule book
parts.what: Versioned plain-language rules on the kit's rules library (KIT-A10-F5-P1), changed only by member vote, with the history public; the promise to remove only what the law requires is a protected rule (SOC-A22-F1-P3).

parts.name: Rules mapped to the law
parts.what: For each rule, the NZ law (or overseas law for overseas members) that requires it.

parts.name: Election period rules
parts.what: NZ election advertising rules and what they mean for posts during an election period.

parts.name: Adult sexual content decision
parts.what: Decide whether lawful adult sexual content is allowed with age checks for viewers and age and consent checks for everyone shown, allowed only outside the app-store apps, or ruled out by a published rule, given UK and Australian age rules, US state age laws, card network and payment provider rules and app store rules; blur labels alone meet none of these.

parts.name: Platform integrity rules
parts.what: Published rules for removals that keep the platform working but are not about illegal content: spam, fake accounts, ban evasion, impersonation, malware and phishing links, and automated floods, each removal naming its rule like any other.

features.name: Illegal material removed fast
features.does: Know that illegal material, such as child abuse and terrorist material, intimate images shared without consent, credible threats, scams and content a court orders down, is found and removed fast.

parts.name: Known-material matching
parts.what: Checks uploads with the kit's known-content matching (KIT-A10-F10-P2) against hash lists from authorised bodies, such as PDQ for images; video hashes come with SOC-A13-F3-P10.

parts.name: NZ legal duties
parts.what: What NZ requires and how fast: objectionable material and DIA take-down notices, the Harmful Digital Communications Act 2015 (intimate images, and its safe harbour of passing a complaint to the author within 48 hours), court orders, fraud and scams, illegal sales such as arms and drugs, incitement under the Human Rights Act 1993, privacy, defamation and copyright.

parts.name: Overseas legal duties
parts.what: Duties for overseas members, such as the EU Digital Services Act, the UK Online Safety Act and Australia's Online Safety Act.

parts.name: Urgent escalation
parts.what: A fast lane to police and the Department of Internal Affairs for child safety and threats to life, with evidence kept as the law requires.

parts.name: Country-only restriction
parts.what: Hide a post only in a country whose law requires it, logged in public, instead of removing it everywhere, and only where the demand passes the published test (SOC-A13-F3-P7).

parts.name: NZ court orders
parts.what: Name suppression breaches, take-down orders under the 2019 contempt of court law and Harmful Digital Communications Act orders handled fast and limited to NZ where the order is, each logged without repeating the suppressed detail.

parts.name: Whose laws count
parts.what: A published policy on which governments' removal demands are obeyed, tested against human rights principles such as the Global Network Initiative's, with every demand and its outcome logged in public.

parts.name: Legal deadline clock and on-call cover
parts.what: A clock for each kind of notice (Harmful Digital Communications Act 48 hours, eSafety 24 hours, US TAKE IT DOWN Act 48 hours, DIA take-down notices and live terror content as soon as reasonably practicable), an on-call rota across time zones, and alerts before any deadline is missed.

parts.name: Scams and fraud taken down
parts.what: Fraud and scams are illegal and removed under the same rules, with a fast path for scams that use deepfakes of public figures or impersonate brands.

parts.name: Known video and crisis protocol
parts.what: Video hashes for known terror and abuse video (vPDQ or TMK+PDQF, released openly by Meta, licence checked before use), GIFCT hash sharing, and the Christchurch Call crisis protocol for live attacks.

parts.name: EU and UK platform duties
parts.what: An EU legal representative and contact points, a notice form and statements of reasons under the EU Digital Services Act, its extra platform duties once the co-op is no longer a small enterprise, and the UK Online Safety Act illegal-content risk assessment, built with the kit's overseas platform duties (KIT-A18-F13-P1); open protocols reach EU and UK members from day one.

features.name: Copyright notices
features.does: Send a copyright notice, answer one with a counter-notice, and see the outcome.

parts.name: Notice and counter-notice
parts.what: Notice and counter-notice forms for posts and videos, tracked on the kit's legal notice deadlines (KIT-A10-F9-P2) and sharing forms with the kit's listing notices (KIT-A10-F21-P2), fitting the NZ Copyright Act 1994 and the US notice process.

parts.name: Rights-holder matching research
parts.what: How open audio and video fingerprinting could flag likely matches for human review, never automatic strikes.

parts.name: Repeat infringer policy
parts.what: A published policy for accounts with repeated upheld copyright notices.

parts.name: Trade mark complaints
parts.what: Trade mark and brand complaints about handles, pages and channels, with a counter-notice and the outcome logged; the kit's trade mark notices cover listings only (KIT-A10-F21).

features.name: See every removal in public
features.does: Browse a public log of every removal, ban, label and section move, with the rule broken, and read regular reports.

parts.name: Public removal log
parts.what: Spare Social's actions in the kit's public removal log (KIT-A10-F7-P1): every removal, ban, label and section move with its rule, searchable, never exposing victims or illegal material, with moderators shown by pseudonymous IDs (SOC-A13-F7-P7).

parts.name: Transparency reports
parts.what: Regular counts per rule, appeal outcomes and government requests as open data, built by the kit's transparency reports (KIT-A10-F15-P1).

features.name: Appeal any decision
features.does: Appeal a removal, ban, label or move, get a different moderator, then a member panel.

parts.name: Appeals
parts.what: Two-step appeals with deadlines: a fresh moderator, then a member panel drawn at random by the kit (KIT-A11-F4-P1, KIT-A11-F5-P1), with the outcome logged.

parts.name: Statement of reasons
parts.what: The person whose post, account or group was acted on is told the rule, the reason and how to appeal, through the kit's statements of reasons (KIT-A10-F8-P1).

features.name: Moderators members elect
features.does: Vote for moderators with fixed terms, and see what tools and limits they work under.

parts.name: Moderator elections
parts.what: Elections, terms and recall through the kit's elections (KIT-A12-F6-P1), with one vote per person on the member register, never per profile, pseudonymous account or agent.

parts.name: Moderator workbench
parts.what: Spare Social's queues, context, past decisions and rule picker on the kit's moderator tools (KIT-A10-F6-P3), with every action logged.

parts.name: Moderator wellbeing
parts.what: Blurred previews, exposure limits, rotation and paid support for people who review harmful material.

parts.name: Moderator vetting and training
parts.what: Checks before anyone reviews the worst material, using the kit's background checks (KIT-A2-F9-P2) where the law allows, and training and certificates from the kit's training module (KIT-A25-F2-P1).

parts.name: Handling objectionable material lawfully
parts.what: A legal basis for moderators handling objectionable material, which is an offence to possess in NZ: hash matches go straight to DIA, and a person sees such material only when they must, blurred first, with every view logged.

parts.name: Moderators' status and safety duties
parts.what: Whether paid moderators are employees or contractors, how their pay is taxed, and the co-op's health and safety duties to every moderator, volunteers included, under the Health and Safety at Work Act 2015.

parts.name: Moderators protected from retaliation
parts.what: Pseudonymous moderator IDs in the public log and in appeals, so decisions stay open without exposing who made each one, and safety support for elected moderators who become public figures.

features.name: Stop spam, bots and fake accounts
features.does: Keep feeds and comments free of spam and fake networks, by published methods.

parts.name: New-account limits
parts.what: New-account limits on the kit's spam limits (KIT-A10-F11-P1), set by Spare Social's rules and easing as an account earns trust.

parts.name: Spam detection
parts.what: Spam detection on published signals such as repeated links and copy-paste floods.

parts.name: Fake network research
parts.what: Proven ways to find coordinated fake accounts, and what can be published without helping spammers.

features.name: Police and government requests
features.does: Know that any request for your data is checked against the law, told to you where allowed, and counted in public.

parts.name: Request desk
parts.what: Uses the kit's published process for police and court requests (KIT-A10-F9-P3), tracked on its deadlines (KIT-A10-F9-P2): intake, legal check, member notice where allowed, and counts for the transparency report.

features.name: Get intimate images taken down fast
features.does: Have an intimate image or sexual deepfake of you removed, with known copies, within 48 hours, even without an account, and stopped from coming back.

parts.name: Intimate image report form
parts.what: A clearly shown public form, usable without an account, for intimate images shared without consent and sexual deepfakes, answered by the kit's trained responders (KIT-A10-F18-P2).

parts.name: Removal within 48 hours
parts.what: Removes the image and known copies within 48 hours, as the US TAKE IT DOWN Act requires since 19 May 2026, and faster where NZ's Harmful Digital Communications Act or Australia's eSafety Commissioner asks.

parts.name: Re-upload blocking
parts.what: Hashes of removed images block re-uploads, and people can add hashes made on their own device, in the way StopNCII works, without ever sending the image.

features.name: Know the steps before a ban
features.does: See a published ladder of warning, time-limited suspension and ban for repeated legal breaches, applied the same way to everyone, with expiry and a way back.

parts.name: Enforcement ladder
parts.what: Published steps for repeated breaches such as threats or sharing intimate images: a warning, a suspension for a set time, a ban, when each step expires, and how an account is restored.

parts.name: Strikes and restoring
parts.what: Records each upheld breach as a strike that expires on time, applies the next step on the ladder, and restores the account when a ban ends or an appeal wins.

features.name: Ask for your image to come down
features.does: Ask for a photo or video that shows you, your child or your home to be blurred or removed, even if you are not a member.

parts.name: Privacy complaints about people shown
parts.what: A complaint path for bystanders, children and anyone else shown in someone else's photo or video, tested against the Privacy Act 2020 and the Harmful Digital Communications Act principles, with blurring offered before removal where that is enough.

features.name: Safety bodies heard fast, decisions checked
features.does: Know reports from recognised safety bodies such as Netsafe, DIA and eSafety are reviewed first, and that a sample of decisions gets a second look.

parts.name: Trusted flaggers
parts.what: A priority queue for recognised safety bodies, such as Netsafe (NZ's approved agency under the Harmful Digital Communications Act), DIA and eSafety, on the kit's trusted flaggers (KIT-A10-F17-P1), which must move up to next for this.

parts.name: Second review and conflict checks
parts.what: A random sample of moderator decisions gets a second review, agreement rates are published, and moderators declare conflicts of interest, using the kit's decision sampling (KIT-A10-F20-P1).

features.name: Moderation in every language
features.does: Know posts in every language members use are moderated, with machine translation for moderators and the original always shown.

parts.name: Moderators for each language
parts.what: Recruits and elects moderators for each language members post in, with a published list of the languages covered and the gaps.

parts.name: Translation for moderators
parts.what: Machine translation in the moderator tools with the original always shown, using the kit's translation service (KIT-A19-F10-P2).

areas.name: Young people and wellbeing
areas.summary: Minimum-age rules for each country, safe defaults for teens, protection from grooming, sextortion and scams, child safety risk assessments, family supervision that teens can see, money rules for young people, time tools for everyone, and help for people in crisis.

features.name: Age rules for each country
features.does: Join only if you meet your country's minimum age, checked in the way the law there requires.

parts.name: Age rules engine
parts.what: Minimum ages, teen settings and consent ages per country, applied at sign-up and when the law changes; a candidate kit service beside the kit's minimum-age rule (KIT-A1-F1-P5) and age checks (KIT-A2-F8), since Spare Market, Spare Ride and others need the same rules.

parts.name: Age assurance
parts.what: Age checks through the kit's age assurance (KIT-A2-F8-P1), returning only whether a person is over the age set and meeting the biometric code (SOC-A14-F1-P5).

parts.name: Minimum-age law research
parts.what: Australia's under-16 law, NZ's minimum age bill introduced in August 2026 (passage unverified), and UK and EU child rules.

parts.name: Parent consent where the law asks
parts.what: Gets a parent's consent where a country's law asks for it before a young person's data is used, such as the EU's GDPR article 8 and the US children's privacy rule (COPPA).

parts.name: Biometric code for faces
parts.what: Facial age estimation, face blurring and any face or person detection meet NZ's Biometric Processing Privacy Code (issued 2025, amended 2026; start dates to be checked), building on the kit's compliance work (KIT-A2-F1-P4).

features.name: Teen accounts with safe defaults
features.does: Teens start private, get messages only from people they follow, see sensitive labels hidden, and are not suggested to adults.

parts.name: Teen defaults
parts.what: Private account, limited messages, hidden sensitive labels and no live streaming until an age set by the rules.

parts.name: Adult contact limits
parts.what: Adults cannot find, suggest or message teens they are not connected to; search, suggestions (SOC-A2-F4) and message requests all apply this limit.

features.name: Family supervision
features.does: A parent and teen link accounts; the parent sees time spent and who the teen follows, never message contents.

parts.name: Linked family accounts
parts.what: Linking that needs both to agree, and that the teen can always see.

parts.name: Family dashboard
parts.what: Time spent, limits, follows and blocks, in one place for the parent.

features.name: Time tools for everyone
features.does: Set a daily limit, quiet hours and break reminders, and hide like and view counts.

parts.name: Time counter on the device
parts.what: Time spent counted on the device only, never sent anywhere.

parts.name: Limits, quiet hours and breaks
parts.what: Daily limits, quiet hours that hold notifications, and break reminders.

parts.name: Hide counts
parts.what: Hide like and view counts on your own posts, on everyone's, or both.

features.name: Help in a crisis
features.does: When someone searches for or posts about self-harm, they see local help such as 1737 in NZ, and anyone can flag a person at risk.

parts.name: Help resources per country
parts.what: Uses the kit's helplines for each country (KIT-A10-F1-P3), such as 1737 in NZ, kept current.

parts.name: Person-at-risk reports
parts.what: A report path reviewed by a person fast, with help sent to the person at risk.

features.name: A space for children
features.does: Give children under the minimum age a separate space of chosen videos, run by their parents.

parts.name: Children's space research
parts.what: What the law allows for under-13s in NZ and overseas, and whether the co-op should offer it at all.

parts.name: Children's space
parts.what: Channels approved by parents, with no comments, no messages and no discovery.

features.name: Protection from grooming and sextortion
features.does: As a teen, get a warning when a new or unconnected adult asks for images or money, and fast help if someone threatens you with images.

parts.name: Risky request warnings
parts.what: On the device, warns a teen when a new or unconnected adult asks for images, money or a move to another app, without sending the messages anywhere.

parts.name: Sextortion help
parts.what: A fast path for a teen threatened with images: block, report, removal through the intimate image path (SOC-A13-F10) and local help, with plain advice not to pay.

features.name: Scam warnings
features.does: See a warning when a message or post looks like a scam, such as an investment pitch using a deepfake of a public figure.

parts.name: Scam warnings in chats and posts
parts.what: Uses the kit's scam warnings (KIT-A8-F9-P1) in chats and on posts, run on the device in encrypted chats so no message leaves it.

features.name: Children's safety checked by design
features.does: Know Spare Social has assessed its risks to children and meets children's design codes before features ship.

parts.name: Children's risk assessment
parts.what: A child safety risk assessment for each feature, as the UK Online Safety Act requires and NZ's Online Safety (Minimum Age and Child Safety Risk Assessment) Bill proposes (introduced 24 August 2026; passage unverified), refreshed when features change.

parts.name: Children's design codes
parts.what: Meets the UK Age Appropriate Design Code and Australia's Children's Online Privacy Code (due to be registered by 10 December 2026), with each finding turned into a setting or a rule.

features.name: Money rules for young people
features.does: As a teen, tip or join memberships only within limits a parent approves, and get paid as a young creator through a guardian.

parts.name: Teen spending limits
parts.what: Spending limits and parent approval for tips, memberships and purchases by teens.

parts.name: Young creators' payouts
parts.what: Under-18 creators are paid out through a guardian's account, since payment providers require adult account holders.

parts.name: Children in paid content
parts.what: Rules for children shown in paid or sponsored content, including setting aside their share of earnings where laws such as those in Illinois, California and Minnesota ask.

areas.name: Creator support and money
areas.summary: Members pay creators directly: tips, monthly memberships with perks, one-off purchases, payouts, tax, honest sponsorship labels, shop links and refunds, sold in ways the app stores allow and protected from fraud. Creators keep everything except the payment fees, and there are no adverts.

features.name: Tip a creator
features.does: Send a creator a tip on a post, video or stream, all of which reaches them, and see what the card payment cost.

parts.name: Tips
parts.what: Tips on the kit's tips (KIT-A3-F6-P1): the whole tip reaches the creator with no co-op fee, and the card cost is carried as a running cost on the open cost ledger, never taken from the tip, the same rule as every app.

parts.name: Tip button
parts.what: A tip button on posts, videos, profiles and live streams.

parts.name: Card cost shown
parts.what: The card cost of each tip shown before paying, with where it is carried on the open cost ledger, under the kit's one rule for tips (KIT-A3-F6-P1).

features.name: Memberships
features.does: Join a creator's monthly membership for members-only posts, videos, chats and badges.

parts.name: Recurring payments and tiers
parts.what: Monthly tiers with prices set by the creator, on the kit's regular payments (KIT-A3-F12-P1).

parts.name: Members-only content
parts.what: Members become an audience for posts, videos, stories and chats, with signed media links.

parts.name: Member badges and lists
parts.what: Badges for members and a member list for the creator.

parts.name: Fair membership terms
parts.what: Cancel in one step, get notice before any price change, and get the refunds consumer law gives, including overseas auto-renewal rules.

features.name: Buy a video or series
features.does: Pay once to watch a video, course or series a creator sells.

parts.name: One-off purchases
parts.what: Single purchases unlocking a video or series for the buyer, sold in the way each app store allows (SOC-A15-F10).

features.name: Get paid out
features.does: Set up payouts once, see your balance and statements, and get paid on a regular schedule.
